rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Node.js-based MySQL MCP server that provides secure database access with multi-database support, lazy loading connection pools, and configurable security levels ranging from read-only operations to full SQL command access. Features hot reloading of database configurations without restart, explicit database parameter requirements to prevent accidental queries, and comprehensive table schema information through SHOW CREATE TABLE commands. Built for developers who need to interact with multiple MySQL databases through AI assistants like Claude and VS Code, with particular emphasis on security through command whitelisting and connection management efficiency through on-demand pool creation.
